sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Associated in Sylvanas's mind with budget argument and formal greens

establishedFacts.fact: The Convocation chamber is at Sunfury Spire in Silvermoon; Sylvanas sits a bench there in formal greens.
The Convocation sits tomorrow on the patrol budget; men who have never drawn a bow argue what bows cost. A magister's nephew has figures about southern posts' new bowstaves.
From the troll hollow, Silvermoon is reachable by dusk on horse; the old road north from the fork leads there.
